value.answer: Six years of backend engineering experience in production. At Northwind Robotics, owned an order-routing service handling ~2M events/day using TypeScript, Node.js, and PostgreSQL. At Vertex Logistics, led a team of five across dispatch and billing for two years. Migrated a monolith to event-driven services with zero customer-visible downtime, cutting p99 checkout latency from 1.9s to 340ms. Experience with Kubernetes, Terraform, PostgreSQL, and TypeScript/Node.js.
